name: Time to Strike
summary: At the Hillsbrad border, Time to Strike carries Lesh's signal east to Tarren Mill. Her coded message moves word from a quiet watch to Forsaken plans against Hillsbrad's humans.

sections.title: A Watcher at the Border
sections.body: Deathstalker Lesh watches the valley from high ground near the border of Silverpine Forest and the Hillsbrad Foothills. Below, human settlers and militia move through the valley. The Deathstalkers serve as the Undercity's eyes and ears, watching enemy settlements before troops deploy. Lesh stays at her post and asks passing Horde travelers to carry her gathered intelligence down the road to Tarren Mill.

sections.title: A Coded Beckon
sections.body: Lesh's message is veiled: “The raven's cry from the west doth beckon.” Carried east along the road, it tells High Executor Darthalia that Hillsbrad's human defenses are vulnerable. For Darthalia and the dreadlord Varimathras, the signal means the time has come to mobilize Forsaken forces and carry out campaigns against Hillsbrad's human defenders.

faq.q: What does Deathstalker Lesh's message mean?
aliases: what does the raven cry mean
faq.answer: “The raven's cry from the west doth beckon” is a coded reconnaissance update. It tells High Executor Darthalia that Hillsbrad's western approaches are poorly guarded and ripe for an immediate offensive.

High Executor Darthalia is the supreme Forsaken military commander in the Hillsbrad Foothills. From Tarren Mill, she directs attacks against the Southshore humans and works closely with Varimathras in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why does Lesh send a courier instead of going herself?
faq.answer: Lesh is on a critical reconnaissance mission at Hillsbrad's western edge. Leaving her post would leave a blind spot in Forsaken surveillance, so she asks passing Horde travelers to carry her urgent dispatches.

faq.q: Where is this message meant to be delivered?
faq.answer: The message is meant for Tarren Mill, the main Horde stronghold in the region. Carry it east along the main road through the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is Varimathras involved in Hillsbrad's affairs?
faq.answer: Varimathras is Sylvanas Windrunner's chief lieutenant and dreadlord advisor. From Undercity's Royal Quarter, he oversees significant parts of Forsaken military and strategic planning, while High Executor Darthalia carries out his campaign orders on the regional front.

faq.q: What happens after this message is received?
faq.answer: When Darthalia learns Hillsbrad is vulnerable, she authorizes aggressive offensive strikes. Horde champions are sent to dismantle the farms, militia, and infrastructure of Hillsbrad.

angles.text: As Forsaken operatives, you help secure Lordaeron's eastern frontier against remnants of the human Alliance when you carry Lesh's dispatch.
As a rogue, you recognize the covert watch and coded messages used by the Deathstalkers, the Undercity's elite guild of assassins and scouts.
As a member of the Horde, you are drawn deeper into the conflict between the Forsaken and the southern human settlements.
